scope: All work in original task turn: inspection, planning, implementation, validation, reporting. Follow-up turns excluded. No subagents.
starting_counter_status: No token_count before task_started; fresh session. Zero baseline inferred from first cumulative snapshot matching last_token_usage; not a pre-task recorded snapshot.

projected_estimate.assumptions: One agent, local archive contains usable source/fixture; expanded course and enrollment implementation, tests, lint/build and reporting; cumulative input across model calls dominates. Estimate only, not measured usage.

baseline_method: inferred from first cumulative minus first last_token_usage in fresh session; no pre-task token_count exists

accounting_rules.method: ending cumulative counters minus starting cumulative counters; cumulative snapshots never summed

estimated_cost.scope: Original implementation turn including its final assistant response; all follow-up publication work excluded. No subagents used.
estimated_cost.tier_verification: Service tier is not recorded in session turn_context; Standard assumed from operator rate card.
estimated_cost.long_context_pricing: Official model page: above 272K input, 2x input/cache and 1.5x output; no recorded request crosses threshold.
estimated_cost.source: Operator-supplied rate-card image, corroborated with https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol on 2026-10-21
exclusions: Account subscription fees, taxes, credits and any unexposed tool-side model/billing usage
estimated_cost.formula: (input - cached_input)*2/1e6 + cached_input*0.10/1e6 + cache_write*2.50/1e6 + output*10/1e6; reasoning output already included in output.

cost_note: API-equivalent estimate at operator-supplied Standard rates; not recorded billing. See estimated_cost assumptions and exclusions.
accounting_coverage: Complete exposed native Codex counters for original main turn. No subagents. Automatic approval-review or tool-side model counters, if incurred, are unexposed and unmeasured.
